hearth.companion.talk.none: Nobody I'd send with you. The brave ones have work, and the greedy ones have drunk their wages.
hearth.companion.talk.named: There's %s. Any of them would go with you, for the coin.
hearth.companion.talk.full: You already have %s hands with you.
hearth.companion.talk.hired: Right then. Where you go, I go, so long as the coin comes at dawn.
hearth.companion.talk.cannot_pay: Come back when you can pay %s.
hearth.companion.talk.no_room: Not today. (The world is too crowded for one more just now.)
hearth.companion.talk.hold_ok: I'll hold back, then. Shout if you need me.
hearth.companion.talk.home_ok: Home it is. Remember me if you need a hand again.
hearth.companion.talk.taken: I'll take good care of the %s.
hearth.companion.talk.returned: Here, all of it. Not a scratch on it. Well, a few.
hearth.companion.talk.wage_owed: %s a day, and you owe me %s days of it.
hearth.companion.talk.wage_glad: %s a day, at dawn, and you've never missed. I'd follow you for less. Don't tell anyone.
hearth.companion.talk.wage_fair: %s a day, at dawn. That's the bargain.
hearth.companion.talk.wage_sour: %s a day. Some days I wonder whether it's enough.
hearth.companion.unpaid: You could not pay %s the day's %s. They will not stay long unpaid.
hearth.companion.died: %s of %s died in your service. Their family will hear of it.
hearth.companion.say.unpaid_leave: No coin, no company. I'm going home.
hearth.companion.say.disloyal_leave: I'll not stand by while you rob my own people. I'm going home.
hearth.household.talk.keep: Will you keep my %s? %s a day, from my bank.
hearth.household.talk.full: That house has all the servants its beds allow (%s).
hearth.household.talk.no_bank: I'd want paying from a bank, not a promise.
hearth.household.talk.kept: I'll keep your %s as if it were my own. %s a day, mind.
hearth.household.talk.gone: As you say. I'll find work elsewhere.
hearth.household.talk.wage_fair: %s a day, from your bank, and paid every day so far.
hearth.household.talk.wage_owed: %s a day, and the bank has refused %s days of it.
hearth.household.left_unpaid: %s has left your house in %s: three days unpaid.
hearth.household.left_sold: %s no longer keeps your house in %s: it is not yours any more.
hearth.household.report.away: Welcome home. You've been gone %s days. Here's what happened:
hearth.household.report.folk: Folk in town call you a %s.
hearth.household.report.spent: The house has cost your bank %s since you left.
hearth.household.report.larder_short: The larder is low (%s portions): the bank would not pay the baker.
hearth.burgher.talk.oath: I would swear the burgher's oath (fee %s).
hearth.burgher.talk.rights_text: No market dues (%s in a hundred off what you buy and on what you sell), the guards let a burgher wear his arms in peace, a seat at the high table at feasts, a pew at mass, and a voice in the council when it sits.
hearth.burgher.talk.sworn: Then it is done. %s, burgher of %s. Sign here.
hearth.burgher.talk.sworn_scene: Then it is done, %s, burgher of %s. Come, the town will witness it.
hearth.burgher.talk.vote: Council: let the %s be built first.
hearth.burgher.talk.vote_taken: Your voice is heard: the %s. The council closes tomorrow.
hearth.burgher.why.standing: The council takes the oath only from those the town trusts (standing %s).
hearth.burgher.why.held: Property held %s days before the oath; %s to go.
hearth.burgher.why.market: The oath is sworn on a market day, before the town.
hearth.burgher.why.owner: A burgher holds property in the town.
hearth.burgher.why.already: You are a burgher here already.
hearth.burgher.oath.text.temperate: "I swear to keep the peace of this town, to pay its dues and bear its burdens, to stand with its people at the gate and at the well, and to hold its charter as my own."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.wisteria: "Under the blossom and before the hall, I swear to keep this town's peace, pay its dues, and hold its charter dear."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.northern: "By hearth and hall I swear: the town's peace is my peace, its dues my dues, its foes my foes."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.alpine: "Before the mountain and this council I swear to keep the peace of the valley, to pay its dues, and to stand with it in hard winters."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.tundra: "By the long dark and the fire that outlasts it, I swear to share this town's burdens and keep its peace."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.moorland: "On the moor's stone I swear to keep this town's peace and pay its dues, in wet years and dry."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.maritime: "By the tide and the harbour I swear to keep this town's peace, pay its dues, and pull my oar with its people."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.tropical: "Under the canopy, before the council, I swear to keep this town's peace and share its harvests and its burdens."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.desert: "By the well and the shade I swear to keep this town's peace, pay its dues, and guard its water as my own."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.mediterranean: "Before the council and the old stones I swear to keep the peace of this town, pay its dues and honour its charter."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.steppe: "Before the elders and the open sky I swear to keep this camp's peace and ride with its people."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.karst: "Before the hall and the hollow hills I swear to keep this town's peace and pay its dues."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.bayou: "By the slow water I swear to keep this town's peace, pay its dues, and stand with its people when the floods come."
hearth.burgher.oath.text.mesa: "Before the red cliffs and this council I swear to keep this town's peace and share its burdens."
hearth.retinue.talk.served: Then serve, %s. Swear the pledge of service when you are ready, and prove it with deeds.
hearth.retinue.talk.ask: Have you a commission for me?
hearth.retinue.talk.nothing: Nothing that needs you just now. Come back in a day or two.
hearth.retinue.talk.rise: I would rise in your service: %s.
hearth.retinue.talk.risen: So be it. From today you are %s of this house.
hearth.retinue.talk.at_throne: A knight is made at the throne, before the court. Come to the hall.
hearth.retinue.talk.dubbed: Kneel. Rise, %s, knight of this household.
hearth.retinue.talk.dubbed_scene: Kneel before the court. Rise, %s, knight of this household.
hearth.retinue.talk.rights: What does my service give me?
hearth.retinue.rights.none: Nothing yet: you do not serve this house.
hearth.retinue.rights.petitioner: A hearing, and a chance. Serve %s well and you will be more than a petitioner.
hearth.retinue.rights.retainer: Lodging at the keep of %s and toll-free passage on his lordship's roads.
hearth.retinue.rights.sworn: Lodging at the keep of %s, toll-free passage, a horse from the stables, and the right to wear his lordship's colours.
hearth.retinue.rights.knight: All a sworn man has, and a house in %s by deed. You are of the household now.
hearth.retinue.why.pledge: Swear the pledge of service first.
hearth.retinue.why.title: The seat must call you a Friend.
hearth.retinue.why.standing: Your standing in the seat must be %s or better.
hearth.retinue.why.feat: Win a tournament or repel a raid in his lordship's colours.
hearth.retinue.why.top: There is no higher rank in this household.
hearth.retinue.may_rise: You may now ask to rise in the service of the lord of %s.
hearth.retinue.heir: A new lord holds %s. Your service is kept one rank lower until you pledge yourself again.
hearth.retinue.horse: A groom brings you a horse from his lordship's stables.
hearth.retinue.house: The steward hands you the deed to a house in %s.
hearth.retinue.no_house: There is no house free in the seat yet; the steward will find you one.
hearth.retinue.dubbed_heard: %s is dubbed a knight of the household of %s, at %s.
